items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: I didn't know too much about her, but I knew him long before he ever got married because he was in my house all the time with my husband.

ctx.x: They stayed together quite a while. They stayed together. I think they finally did separate in late years. When he died, Joe was over in Savannah. She was back here.

I didn't know too much about her, but I knew him long before he ever got married because he was in my house all the time with my husband. All those young boys. And most of them weren't married. No. As I say, they'd just flock and that's all he was, his work and his music too.
Most of the time he had his own band. Most of the time.
